title: Dragon Castle Waters
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a dark multi-towered dragon-like castle with glowing eyes and claws looming over a swirling blue sea under an orange sky with a sun and crescent moon. In the foreground, a woman in a pink dress stands in a sailboat with spiral patterns while another woman in blue kneels on a rocky shore operating a large blue wheel that controls the water's concentric spirals.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene of a giant black dragon-shaped castle with glowing white eyes and claws rising from the water, set against an orange sky with a bright sun and green crescent moon. Several colorful sailboats with spiral sails navigate a bright blue sea with concentric swirling patterns and yellow dots. In the foreground a woman in a pink dress stands in a boat while another woman in blue kneels on the rocky shore turning a large ornate blue wheel that manipulates the water currents, vibrant colors, detailed illustration style.
